name: Tangram Dock
description: Fit three unusual cargo shapes into a perfectly packed dock.
rules: Choose a piece, then an empty square for its top-left corner.
Fill every square without overlaps. Remove a placed piece by choosing it again.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Mirror Mail
description: Deliver a beam through a tiny mirrored sorting room.
rules: Tap mirrors to turn them between / and \.
Send light from the left entrance to the bottom delivery port.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Bilateral
description: Restore the missing half of a woven reflection.
rules: The left pattern is fixed. Toggle squares on the right.
Match the exact horizontal reflection across the seam.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Shadow Turn
description: Turn four silhouettes until their shadows agree.
rules: Each large cutout turns one quarter clockwise when tapped.
Match all four cutouts to their small reference silhouettes.
Complete all three curated studies to finish the round.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Loose Ends
description: Exchange crossing points to untangle a knotted necklace.
rules: Select a point, then another point to swap their positions.
Remove every crossing between non-adjacent cords.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Gear Train
description: Plan three compound transmissions, from paired reducers to a locked input and a mixed-speed train.
rules: Select a gear, then its neighbor in the A → B → C bench order to exchange them. Each exchange counts once; selecting the same gear again cancels. Bolted sockets cannot move.
Each mesh must meet its displayed teeth ratio: driver teeth ÷ follower teeth. Mesh ratios multiply into the output speed, but the correct final product alone is not enough.
Test the train to certify a study, then choose Next study. Finish all three. Undo reverses a swap; Reset this study keeps earlier progress; Restart begins the whole journey.
controls: Select adjacent bench gears by tap or keyboard Enter/Space. Test certifies a study; Undo reverses a swap. Three studies with four then six sockets.

name: Measured Pour
description: Measure a precise parcel of water with two unmarked jugs.
rules: Fill, empty, or pour between the 3L and 5L jugs.
Leave exactly 4L in the large jug. Pours stop when full or empty.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Rover Script
description: Write a short route for a little delivery rover.
rules: Queue forward, left, or right commands; Run executes the route.
Collect the parcel and reach the flag without hitting walls. Clear edits your program.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Paper Trail
description: Fold a marked strip into one perfectly aligned stack.
rules: Fold the left or right half onto the other half.
Match the target top-to-bottom layer order after three folds.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Pigment Lab
description: Move translucent ink stencils to restore three layered prints.
rules: Choose a cyan, magenta or yellow stencil, then tap its top-left anchor on your print. Stencils may overlap but must fit on the paper.
Rotate turns the selected stencil clockwise and lifts it for repositioning. Match the reference, including all blank cells.
Complete three different print studies. C, M and Y letters identify inks and mixtures, so color is never the only clue.
controls: Tap a stencil, Rotate if needed, then a grid square. Tab and Enter / Space operate every control. Lift removes the selected stencil.

name: Cable Loom
description: Thread a cable through every brass peg in one stroke.
rules: Begin at S and tap a neighboring peg to extend the cable.
Visit every peg once, finishing at E. Undo retracts one segment.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Balance Mobile
description: Compose three balanced sculptures, from symmetry to fixed anchors and uneven arms.
mechanic: Progressive torque placement with asymmetric arms and fixed anchors
rules: Choose a free weight, then an empty hook. A hung free weight can be lifted by selecting it again. Every available weight must be used once.
Balance total left and right torque: each weight contributes its mass multiplied by its distance from the center. The sculpture tilts toward the heavier torque.
Complete three sculptures. Green anchor weights and hooks marked FIXED cannot move. Later sculptures use unequal arm distances; Restart begins all three again.
controls: Tap a weight and hook, or use Tab then Enter / Space. Lettered hooks show side and distance; numeric torque and tilt both reflect the arrangement.

name: Crate Crane
description: Sort a little freight yard using only its top containers.
rules: Select a stack to lift its top crate, then a destination.
Stacks hold three crates. Make the left stack all A and the right stack all B.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Orbit Transfer
description: Navigate a one-way constellation while collecting every beacon.
rules: Travel along an available arrow from your current station.
Collect the three beacons, then dock at F before the 8-step fuel reserve runs out.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.

name: Stamp Studio
description: Compose a print from overlapping transparent stamps.
rules: Toggle stamps in the tray to overlay their ink.
Match the target print. Ink only adds: extra squares cannot be erased by another stamp.
Complete all three curated studies to finish the round.
controls: Tap or click buttons. Tab and Enter / Space work throughout.
